stem: Why was there significant opposition to the Fugitive Slave Act?

options.label: A
options.text: Because fugitive enslaved people wanted to establish a new government in territories in the West

options.label: B
options.text: Because fugitive enslaved people were provided with paid passage out of the country

options.label: C
options.text: Because it was part of a scheme by Northern officials that expanded slavery into the territories

options.label: D
options.text: Because it was used to provide federal support for the institution of slavery
